headline: Agents Turn Natural Language Into Reliable Tests
lede: e2e gives testing teams a procedural route from plain-language goals to verified browser and mobile workflows. It records successful agent actions for deterministic replay, then anchors them with conventional assertions and CI reporting.

headline: Claude-Mem Gives Coding Agents A Long Memory
lede: Claude-Mem captures sessions, distills them into searchable observations, and streams the relevant history back when work resumes. SQLite storage, hybrid retrieval, citations, and progressive disclosure turn scattered agent activity into a usable project memory.

headline: Pstack Routes Agent Work Through Rigorous Playbooks
lede: pstack-claude replaces improvised prompting with named procedures for debugging, planning, refactoring, investigation, and release work. Its harness integrations coordinate skills, subagents, verification, and model settings across a crowded field of coding agents.

headline: Text-to-CAD Moves Ideas Into Manufacturable Models
lede: text-to-cad gives agents a local fabrication workbench for generating STEP, GLB, STL, and 3MF assets. Skills for design checks, drawings, 3D printing, sheet metal, and CNC connect conversational design to physical output.

headline: T3 Code Puts Coding Agents Under One Roof
lede: T3 Code is a polished control surface for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agent tools, reachable from phones, browsers, and desktop apps. Its local server preserves machine-level access while adding remote sessions, project settings, permissions, and source-control controls.

headline: AnyPS5 Rebuilds Console Software For Desktop Systems
lede: AnyPS5 translates PlayStation 5 executables toward native Linux and Windows formats rather than wrapping them in a conventional emulator. Relinking, PRX compatibility layers, shader recompilation, and explicit unsupported-state errors expose the hard edges of executable portability.

headline: Agent Reach Connects Agents To The Open Web
lede: Agent Reach assembles local, open-source routes into a resilient browsing and retrieval layer for social and technical platforms. Its primary-plus-fallback dispatcher handles shifting access conditions while keeping credentials local and the configuration auditable.

headline: OpenMontage Turns Coding Agents Into Film Crews
lede: OpenMontage sketches a full production pipeline across research, scripting, assets, editing, and delivery. Its Backlot dashboard, 12 pipelines, and validation tools give an experimental creative system enough structure to track footage, budgets, audio, and final renders.

headline: Caddy Makes Secure Web Serving Routine
lede: Caddy combines HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 with automatic certificate management and graceful configuration changes. Its modular Go architecture scales from a simple reverse proxy to clustered production infrastructure without adding a separate runtime dependency.

headline: openGym Keeps Training Data On Your Terms
lede: openGym is a self-hosted workout system for routines, recovery, progression, imports, and long-term records without subscriptions or advertising. Docker deployment, passkeys, offline clients, JSON export, and optional synchronization keep the training history under the owner’s control.
